sessionStart.comment: File reading strategy: use Grep to locate line numbers first, then Read with offset+limit for targeted sections. Tier 1 (<200 lines): full read OK. Tier 2 (200-500 lines): use offset/limit. Tier 3 (500-1000 lines): grep then targeted read. Tier 4 (1000+ lines): Grep only or delegate to Explore. Always prefer rg over grep. Use fd over find. Batch independent tool calls in a single response to reduce turns.

preToolUse.comment: Large file read detected (>50KB). For future reads: use Grep first to find line numbers, then Read with offset+limit. Prefer targeted 50-100 line sections over full file reads.

postToolUse.comment: Large command output detected (>30KB). Pipe future commands through head -n 50 or tail -n 50 to limit output size.
